message.content:
Sure! Those numbers are already the latitude and longitude of the Googleplex in Mountain View, California. If you want to confirm or retrieve the human‑readable address (or any other place details) you can use the **Google Maps Geocoding API** to *reverse‑geocode* that point.

---

## 1. What you already have

| Field | Value |
|-------|-------|
| Latitude | **37.4224764** |
| Longitude | **-122.0842499** |

These coordinates point to:

> **1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA**  
> (the Googleplex)

---

## 2. Reverse‑geocoding with the Geocoding API

### Example request

```http
GET https://maps.googleapis.com/maps/api/geocode/json
    ?latlng=37.4224764,-122.0842499
    &key=YOUR_API_KEY
```

> Replace `YOUR_API_KEY` with a valid Google Maps API key that has the Geocoding API enabled.

### Expected response (abridged)

```json
{
  "results": [
    {
      "address_components": [
        {"long_name":"1600","short_name":"1600","types":["street_number"]},
        {"long_name":"Amphitheatre Parkway","short_name":"Amphitheatre Pkwy","types":["route"]},
        {"long_name":"Mountain View","short_name":"Mountain View","types":["locality","political"]},
        {"long_name":"Santa Clara County","short_name":"Santa Clara County","types":["administrative_area_level_2","political"]},
        {"long_name":"California","short_name":"CA","types":["administrative_area_level_1","political"]},
        {"long_name":"United States","short_name":"US","types":["country","political"]},
        {"long_name":"94043","short_name":"94043","types":["postal_code"]}
      ],
      "formatted_address":"1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA",
      "geometry": {
        "location": {"lat":37.4224764,"lng":-122.0842499},
        "location_type":"ROOFTOP",
        "viewport":{...}
      },
      "place_id":"ChIJj61dQgK6j4AR4J7x5Z8Y5wU",
      "types":["street_address"]
    }
  ],
  "status":"OK"
}
```

---

## 3. Quick sanity check

If you paste the coordinates into Google Maps (or any mapping service) you’ll see the same address:

```
https://www.google.com/maps/@37.4224764,-122.0842499,15z
```

---

### TL;DR

- **Latitude:** 37.4224764  
- **Longitude:** -122.0842499  
- **Address:** 1600 Amphitheatre Parkway, Mountain View, CA 94043, USA  

Use the reverse‑geocode request above to programmatically retrieve this information (or any additional place details) via the Geocoding API.
